SELECT
  hostname,
  date_hour,
  TRY_CAST(total_transactions AS BIGINT) + TRY_CAST(total_retry_packets AS BIGINT) AS total_packets,
  TRY_CAST(request_peak_rate AS DOUBLE) AS peak_rate,
  TRY_CAST(request_current_rate AS DOUBLE) AS current_rate,
  TRY_CAST(request_average_rate AS DOUBLE) AS average_rate
FROM hive__aaa__authentication
WHERE
  date_hour = CURRENT_DATE || ' 00:00'
ORDER BY
  total_packets DESC,
  peak_rate DESC,
  current_rate DESC,
  average_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(TRY_CAST(ha.reject AS BIGINT)) > SUM(TRY_CAST(pc.vonr_abnormal_release AS BIGINT))
    THEN 'hive__aaa__authentication'
    ELSE 'hive__npms__kpi_access5g_5g_cell_peak_view'
  END AS problematic_table,
  SUM(TRY_CAST(ha.reject AS BIGINT)) AS total_rejects_ha,
  SUM(TRY_CAST(pc.vonr_abnormal_release AS BIGINT)) AS total_abnormal_releases_pc
FROM hive__aaa__authentication AS ha
FULL OUTER JOIN hive__npms__kpi_access5g_5g_cell_peak_view AS pc
  ON ha.hostname = pc.object_id AND ha.date_hour = pc.date_hour
GROUP BY
  GROUPING SETS (
    (ha.hostname, ha.date_hour),
    ()
  )
